verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is a vector and full-text search engine, and a data service like this could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, so the axis applies. The evidence shows native embedding, managed-model reranking, and a dashboard for browsing documents and running queries. These are retrieval building blocks and adjacent features, not AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's data. No such capability appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
